reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

title.narrative: Credit Agricole du Maroc - Earthquake response

description.narrative: EBRD is considering the provision of a senior unsecured loan of up to EUR 50 million to be provided in 2 equal tranches of EUR 25 million in MAD equivalent, in favour of Credit Agricole du Maroc ("CAM") (the "Company"), a limited liability company, to support MSMEs, with a focus on the ones located in the regions affected by the 8th September 2023 earthquake. The project will contribute to building a more competitive and resilient economy in Morocco by supporting SME financing. A special focus will be given to distribution of funds in the regions and outreach to new customers. Moreover, the project will support access to finance for MSMEs in the regions affected by the 8th September 2023 earthquake.
